extension.title: Install the AgentOS extension
extension.subtitle: AgentOS connects to MyHome.ge and SS.ge through a small browser extension. Install it once on this computer — it takes about a minute.
extension.unsupported: Use Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a computer — the extension doesn't work on phones, Safari or Firefox.
extension.step1: Download the file above and open your Downloads folder.
extension.step2: Right-click agentos-extension.zip → Extract All. Move the agentos-extension folder somewhere permanent, like Documents — Chrome loads it from there, so don't delete it.
extension.step3: Open a new tab and go to chrome://extensions (in Edge: edge://extensions).
extension.step4: Turn on Developer mode — the switch is in the top-right corner.
extension.step5: Click Load unpacked and select the agentos-extension folder.
extension.step6: Log in to myhome.ge and ss.ge in this browser, then come back here and press Check again.
extension.updateNote: Got a newer version? Replace the files in the folder with the new ones, then press the ↻ reload icon on the extension's card in chrome://extensions.
